metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-72530: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.. Product: Server
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-72530" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-72530" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-72530" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-REMOTE-CODE-EXECUTION-003
